pricing.title: One campus, every budget
pricing.subtitle: Start free. Upgrade when you need more AI tutoring, certificates, or seats for your school. Annual billing saves two months.
pricing.trialBody: Paid self-serve plans include a 14-day trial (30-day pilots for schools). Cancel anytime during trial, pay nothing.
pricing.payBody: Cards via Stripe (USD) and PayFast (ZAR) — including Instant EFT, SnapScan, and mobicred where available.
pricing.cancelBody: Cancel at period end from your billing portal. You keep access until the paid period finishes — no lock-in.

anatomy.label: Human Atlas
anatomy.description: Explore human systems as an interactive model. Separate structures and inspect how they work together.

plants.label: Plant Systems
plants.description: Trace how roots, vascular tissue, and leaves work together to move water and capture energy.

engineering.label: Bridge Systems
engineering.description: Disassemble a truss bridge to see how forces travel through structure, motion, and load paths.

vehicle.label: Electric Vehicle Systems
vehicle.description: Take apart an electric SUV: energy storage, drive units, chassis, and body systems.

earth.label: Earth Systems
earth.description: Explore the layered planet and inspect the systems that shape its surface and atmosphere.

elementary.label: Elementary
elementary.focus: Wonder and naming: what is it, what does it look like, what does it do?

middle.label: Middle School
middle.focus: Mechanisms: how does it work, and how can you test it?

high.label: High School
high.focus: Laws and proof: why must it behave this way, and how do we know?

university.label: University
university.focus: Generality: under what assumptions does this hold, and where does it break?

professional.label: Professional
professional.focus: Use: how do I apply, verify, or teach this reliably?
